def _get_channel(self):
        """
        Fetch a channel from the pool. Will return a new one if necessary. If
        a channel in the free pool is closed, will remove it. Will return None
        if we hit the cap. Will clean up any channels that were published to
        but closed due to error.
        """
        if self.closed:
            raise RuntimeError("ChannelPool is closed")

        # Clean up any channels that were published to but closed due to error
        self._cleanup_channels()

        # Check if we can use a free channel
        if self._free_channels:
            channel = self._free_channels.pop()
            self._check_channel(channel)
            return channel

        # Check if we can create a new channel
        if self._total_channels < self.max_channels:
            channel = self._create_channel()
            self._check_channel(channel)
            return channel

        # We're at the max channels
        return None
